claims_policy: Equations and predictions are specified; no historical transfer claim is promoted without an authorized once-only confrontation.

equations.access: logit(A_{i,t+1}) = rho_A logit(A_{i,t}) + beta_AP P_{i,t} + beta_AL L_{i,t} - beta_AQ coercion_{i,t} + eps^A_{i,t}
equations.action_hazard: lambda_{i,j,t} = H_{i,j,t} * exp(theta_0 + theta_O O_{i,t} + theta_A A_{i,t} + theta_C C_{i,t} + theta_L L_{i,t} + theta_B f(B_{i,t}))
equations.capacity: logit(O_{i,t+1}) = rho_O logit(O_{i,t}) + beta_OS support_{i,t} + beta_OC C_{i,t} - beta_OX attrition_{i,t} + eps^O_{i,t}
equations.control: C_{i,t+1} = clip(C_{i,t} + beta_CO O_{i,t} + beta_CA A_{i,t} - beta_CR response_{i,t} + eps^C_{i,t}, -1, 1)
equations.reproduction_quantity: R_t = sum_{new footholds j} E[1{j becomes active by t+Delta} | active footholds at t] / max(1, active footholds_t)

predictions.falsifier: No increase or a sign reversal across preregistered synthetic contrasts.
predictions.prediction: Holding exposure fixed, higher civilian access raises delayed foothold survival through capacity accumulation.

predictions.falsifier: Capacity and action move synchronously with no readiness mediation.
predictions.prediction: Logistics shocks reduce realized action through readiness before they reduce latent organizational capacity.

predictions.falsifier: Uncertainty changes total intensity only, with no dispersion effect.
predictions.prediction: Belief uncertainty broadens action-location dispersion rather than simply scaling total action.

predictions.falsifier: Extinction occurs with R_t consistently above one or R_t never responds to the shock.
predictions.prediction: R_t crosses below one after sustained access or logistics loss, preceding extinction of active footholds.

predictions.falsifier: Placebo topology and true topology yield indistinguishable parent attribution.
predictions.prediction: Spatially connected access produces clustered, parent-attributed colonization rather than independent uniform ignition.

recover sign and ordering from blinded simulations
